Author: Akari
Name: Venue Helper
Punchline: Attendance counting, raffles, auctions, and giveaways for venue hosts.
Description:
An all-in-one venue host toolkit.

- Venue Counter: a temporary lap counter (run the venue to catch everyone past the 99-render cap) and an all-night counter, runnable at the same time.
- Raffle Helper: tracks ticket buy-ins by name and world, auto-detects incoming trade gil, assigns ticket numbers 1-999, and exports (including one-line-per-ticket for wheelofnames.com).
- Auction Helper: target a player to add them to an auction list, note what they're auctioning, record the final sale, apply a configurable house cut %, and export. Includes a history tab with totals.
- Giveaway Helper: start a round and capture each player's FIRST /random, then highlight the highest, lowest, and/or closest-to-target roll. Shows every roll for verification.

Exports can be written as TXT, CSV, PDF, or XLSX to a folder you choose.

Usage:
- /venuehelper (aliases /vhelp, /vh) to open the window.
